title: List of unique monsters
wikitext:
{{cargo rework needed}}
[[File:UniqueMob.png|thumb|right|422px|A unique monster. Notice its health bar has a bronze framing with dents on the top and bottom.]]
'''Unique Monsters''' are special monsters with fixed modifiers that appear always in the same zone. 

Listed below are only the unique monsters that are part of the main storyline. [[Map bosses]], [[Invasion Boss]]es, [[Vaal side area|Vaal side area bosses]], summoned monsters during [[Izaro]] fights, [[Beyond Demon]] bosses, [[Tormented Spirit]]s and [[Rogue Exiles]] also have a rarity of unique, but are not featured in this list.
